comparison.objective: Close a swing-top bottle by seating its stopper and driving an over-centre lever; the candidate sets a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual bottle bracing plus articulated toggle operation, not simultaneous wrench/driver counterholding on threads.
comparison.success_condition: Stopper seated, lever past centre, bottle upright, grippers clear for 2 s; candidate instead requires 90° adjustment retained over three cycles.
comparison.reason: Both resist reaction forces and verify a retained state, but one tests over-centre closure while the candidate tests preservation of a threaded setting.
